item.title: Dynamite rating for 12/17/2025
item.description: Dynamite this past Wednesday drew 511,000 viewers, down 5,000 viewers from the prior week. This was the taped episode from Manchester, England. The show had a 0.08 rating in 18-49, down 0.01 from the previous show and ties the lowest number so far. Cable rankings are not available at the moment.
